name: facebook_ad_reach_global_2025
explanation: Facebook advertising reach worldwide. This is an advertising audience estimate, not the same as monthly active users.

name: facebook_ad_reach_us_2025
explanation: Facebook advertising reach in the United States. This is an advertising audience estimate and not the same as active-user counts.

name: facebook_mau_global_2025
explanation: Facebook monthly active users (MAU = monthly active users) worldwide.

name: facebook_time_spent_daily_us_2025
explanation: Average daily time spent on Facebook by users in the United States, as relayed by a secondary source citing eMarketer.

name: meta_family_dap_2025_proxy
explanation: Family daily active people (DAP = daily active people) for Meta in December 2025. This is not Facebook-only and should be interpreted as ecosystem scale, not Facebook platform scale.

name: snap_dau_q4_2025
explanation: Snap global daily active users (DAU = daily active users) in the fourth quarter of 2025.

name: snap_mau_q4_2025
explanation: Snap global monthly active users (MAU = monthly active users) in the fourth quarter of 2025.

name: snapchat_ad_reach_global_2025
explanation: Snapchat global advertising reach. This is an advertising audience estimate and not the same as monthly active users.

name: snapchat_ad_reach_us_2025
explanation: Snapchat advertising reach in the United States. This is an advertising audience estimate and not the same as active-user counts.

name: snapchat_plus_subscribers_q4_2025
explanation: Snapchat+ subscribers in the fourth quarter of 2025.

name: snapchat_time_spent_daily_global_2025
explanation: Average daily time spent on Snapchat by users aged 18 and above globally, relayed by a secondary source.

name: tiktok_ad_reach_global_2025
explanation: TikTok global advertising reach. This is an advertising audience estimate and not the same as total global active users.

name: tiktok_ad_reach_us_adults_2025
explanation: TikTok advertising reach for adults aged 18 and above in the United States. TikTok's public ad tools report adults rather than all users in this source.

name: tiktok_businesses_us_2026
explanation: United States businesses referenced in TikTok's January 2026 announcement.

name: tiktok_time_spent_daily_us_2025
explanation: Average daily time spent on TikTok by users in the United States according to an eMarketer forecast.

name: tiktok_users_europe_2025
explanation: TikTok monthly active recipients in Europe. The company defines this using its Digital Services Act reporting framework.

name: tiktok_users_us_2026
explanation: Users in the United States referenced in TikTok's January 2026 announcement.

name: x_ad_reach_global_2025
explanation: X global advertising reach. This is an advertising audience estimate and not the same as monthly active users.

name: x_ad_reach_us_2025
explanation: X advertising reach in the United States. This is an advertising audience estimate and not the same as active-user counts.

name: x_time_spent_daily_us_2025
explanation: Average daily time spent on X by adults aged 18 and above in the United States, relayed by a secondary source citing eMarketer.

name: youtube_active_users_global_2025
explanation: Estimated YouTube active users worldwide.

name: youtube_ad_reach_global_2025
explanation: YouTube global advertising reach. This is an advertising audience estimate, not the same as monthly active users.

name: youtube_ad_reach_us_2025
explanation: YouTube advertising reach in the United States. This is an advertising audience estimate and not the same as monthly active users.

name: youtube_time_spent_daily_uk_2025
explanation: Average daily time spent watching YouTube in the United Kingdom on smartphones, tablets, and personal computers, according to Ofcom as reported by Reuters.
